description: DRAFT candidate from experiments/covid-rsv-search-20261124 (not installed, for the user to decide). The submitted rsv-four mixture (Ball_c0w512, Bw, A4c0, A4i) plus two members that replace neighbouring-state exchange / no exchange with a US-only summary (Bw.nat.smp: Bw.nat with a sampled trajectory head and log-loss weight 1, preferred over the level quantile Bw.nat; A4i.nat): six recipes, equal weights. Held-out seasons (48 seeds): -2.9% log-admission WIS against the submitted mixture refit the same way, lower in both seasons, rising -2.8%, peak weeks +0.2%, falling -2.6%; 2023-24 guard ED share -0.3% (48 seeds). The four-member variant (draft-release-rsv-nat.json) is -3.5% overall but +3.9% in peak weeks. Checkpoints in the Longleaf campaign folder nowcast-20261113.
